objective: Wire the internal CLI and Pi native tools directly to the shared core package.
scope: Core worktree: thin CLI consumers, direct Node Pi consumers, legacy helper consolidation and functional parity tests.
constraints: Work ONLY /workspace/work/holyagent-034-core, continuing your completed core implementation. Read executable core contracts/docs. You may adjust core APIs while wiring, but keep business decisions in core and strict schemas/authority. Never draft PRs; root owns all source VCS/state. No actual .git/.holyagent writes, external actions, live Pi/model requests, user-machine installs or extra agents. Temporary Node/SDK/Git fixtures are allowed. No external dependency upgrades.

Replace actual state-management logic in CLI handlers with calls to intent/assignment/overview/migration core functions; CLI retains argv/help/plain rendering/stdin/exit adaptation. Preserve every existing flag, selected Intent behavior/links, dispatch prompts/briefs, reports, branch recording and TaggedError semantics. Shared config/profile/lifecycle/warm selection must not be duplicated back in CLI. Consolidate runtime Pi guardrails/settings/routes/journal/provider copies to core compatibility exports so they cannot drift. Utility/host-only unsupported native operations stay explicitly classified, never hidden CLI fallback.

Implement Pi holyagent_* tools using actual @holyagent/core Effects and the shared schemas, no prepared argv, run(argv), parsing CLI stdout, native-process or spawning holyagent CLI. Reference D tree only for policy/inventory/real SDK tests; do NOT copy or merge the superseded subprocess/IPC bridge. Core contains the protected persistence already. Expose every supported core operation; classify every integrated CLI command including handoff, hooks/stdio/passthrough/setup/VCS. Registration, inventory AND execution enforce explicit no-default holyagent-native-root flag plus successful user AND merged enabled config; unknown/off fails closed. Revoke running fibers and deny stale calls on disable/shutdown; hidden registry metadata is not authorization.

Use Node-safe makeContext/loadConfigWithSource and actual core helpers, never CLI helpers for config/status. Host authorize callback is live and adapter-owned; model input cannot supply authority/cwd/host. Preserve actual host tool_call/nested permissions. Propagate AbortSignal to Effect, retaining protected writes/artifact completion and accurate cancelled/may-completed results. Text display escapes terminal controls; structured details remain exact. No claim this secures specialist shell commands or cross-host identity.

Preserve E's profile routing capability: core plans direct fallback when profiles active; port actual exact authenticated/configured model-registry gate for Agent/agent and refuse SubagentWorkflow/subagent_workflow under activated profile/ranking so upstream fuzzy resolver cannot switch provider. Legacy non-profile behavior stays. Read E source/diff as needed, no other-tree edits. F wait/alias and C/G guidance are later merges: keep root flag/config lifecycle centralized and provide the confirmed-enabled signal; don't overwrite their requirements when root integrates them.

Preserve latest H plain output and internal/public setup-origin separation when adapting CLI entries. H repaired source is /workspace/work/holyagent-034-cli plus /workspace/work/034/plain-cli-control-repair.diff (not all committed yet). Copy only needed presenter/entry changes into your owned tree, document provenance. The public bin explicitly opts into existing setup UI; internal entry stays plain even on TTY. Preserve version/deps; root package.json may change ONLY its authorized bin mapping, never version/pins/pi.skills wholesale. Pi generate.ts must bundle both entries and the Node-safe native extension.

Shared package is private and bundled; no new npm publisher. Dependency graph/lock changes go through the new workspace-lock-only updater; preserve external versions. No generated dist edits or full build/verify yet; root coordinates those. Source contract changes must retain direct Node/Bun core tests and CLI/native parity. Actual Node bundle with Bun absent must execute a native tool directly and via SDK codemode while a spy proves no CLI invocation; Git subprocesses are allowed. Test root/child/off/unknown/reload/error/extra-field/cancel paths and real state effects, not only wrapper mocks.

Run meaningful focused suites, type/lint/fmt through env MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/data MISE_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/cache MISE_STATE_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/state MISE_CONFIG_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/config PATH=/workspace/work/tools/mise/bin:/workspace/work/tools/bun/bin:$PATH. Keep working until both consumers actually call core; no foundation-only terminal report. Genuine host limitation needs source/options. JSON /workspace/work/034/core-consumers-report.json status EXACTLY done|partial|blocked,changed_paths,checks:[{command,exit:number}],blockers,notes,evidence:[{key,support}]. Full diff /workspace/work/034/core-consumers.diff. Final <=350 words; logs outside repo.

criteria.text: Actual CLI functionality and supported Pi tools consume shared core APIs directly without CLI proxying
Authority schemas cancellation state semantics and plain output remain compatible across consumers
Real Node SDK and parity tests prove direct execution and deny unsupported or unauthorized paths
